mapper.select: select count(*) from tool_visit where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < curdate() + interval 1 day
select count(*) from tool_info where status = '0'

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, count(*) as cnt from tool_visit where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by statDate

select t.tool_name as toolName, t.tool_route as toolRoute, count(v.id) as visitCount from tool_info t left join tool_visit v on v.tool_id = t.id group by t.id, t.tool_name, t.tool_route order by visitCount desc, t.sort, t.id limit #{limit}
